title: Data Logging & Sensors
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Week 1 Study sheet pp.3-8

scenes.t: Data logging means collecting and saving data automatically. For example, a weather station records the temperature every day.
A data logger is a device that collects and saves data over time. Data means information. Log means keeping a record.
We can monitor many kinds of data, like light, sound, temperature and distance.
A sensor is like a tiny helper that can feel things around it, like light, heat, sound or movement. Then it tells a machine what it feels.
A temperature sensor measures temperature. A light sensor detects light. Phones, computers and tablets use light sensors.
A sound sensor detects sound. Some toys answer when you talk or sing, because they have a sound sensor inside.
A touch sensor detects touch. When you touch a phone screen, the touch sensor feels it and opens the app.
An ultrasonic sensor measures distance. It is used for measuring heights and levels.
A probe is a tool connected to a sensor to help it take a measurement. The sensor does the feeling. The probe is like the hand that helps it reach.
For example, a temperature probe is like the thermometer stick you dip into soup, so the sensor can check the heat.
